newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel reopens tunnel after false alarm.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel reopens tunnel after false alarm.

text.p: Anglo-French Channel Tunnel railway operator Eurotunnel Plc/SA said a fire alarm had caused it to halt a shuttle train carrying lorries and evacuate the truck drivers earlier on Friday, but the alarm proved false and traffic was now running normally.

Eurotunnel began trial services for the lorry shuttles last month to satisfy the authorities that new safety precautions will avoid a repeat of the last year's blaze, which caused 200 million pounds of damage and injured several people.

A company spokesman said it was likely that there would be more interruptions from false alarms as the trials continued. "We have set the alarms at a very low level so they are ultra-sensitive," he said. "We might have set it too low, but we are going to get these false alarms," he said.
But Friday's interruption was brief, he said, causing other trains to be delayed by about 20 minutes.
